introduction: SoonerCare is Oklahoma Medicaid. Use the member portal’s application link, then respond to requests about the people seeking coverage.
description: SoonerCare is Oklahoma Medicaid. Use the member portal’s application link, then respond to requests about the people seeking coverage.

sections.who: OHCA assesses income, status and a coverage category. Categories include children, pregnancy, qualifying adults ages 19–64, parents, older adults and people with disabilities.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps with eligible healthcare. Consult the benefit handbook and provider directory for your category.

sections.apply:
1. Start from MySoonerCare

    Use the member portal and Apply for Benefits.

  2. Complete the household questions

    Review every applicant’s information before submitting and keep your confirmation.

  3. Answer OHCA notices

    Provide requested verification and read the decision and plan instructions.
sections.after: Keep your address, phone and email current. OHCA announces work requirements for some expansion adults starting January 2027, with exemptions; follow your individual notice.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Application portal and helpline, Coverage categories, 2027 work-rule guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Where can I get online application help?
The SoonerCare helpline is 800-987-7767; OHCA also lists local Community Action agencies.
Are the work requirements already effective in October 2026?
OHCA states a January 1, 2027 start date.
Does every adult face those requirements?
No. OHCA lists affected expansion adults and multiple exemptions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
